description: Several large pastel building blocks are spread out on a bed beside a pillow. The left hand reaches in to grasp and slide a blue block forward while the right hand picks up a light-green block from the right, brings it leftward, and sets it snugly against the blue; the right hand then lifts another green block and places it to extend the row, while the left hand steadies the growing arrangement and the right hand adds more pieces, including a white block stacked on top and a yellow block fitted beside it.
